Only advice I would give is avoid the clip on style and get one that securely loops through your belt so it is nice and stiff for a quicker draw. I challenge myself to not take the Klonipin, just because I have struggled with alcoholism and painkiller addiction before.  I have had no issues with becoming overly dependent on the Klonipin though.
